Added step 3.1 proves product continuity by a local boundedness inequality and finite-sum continuity directly, including phi itself; derivative formulas and the Statement are unchanged. No choice principle is used.

The computed SVD Definition already tests any u_i<=tau before looking for straddling intervals. Corrected proof 3.1 to preserve that precedence; exact QR and SVD both may return an exact step. Also corrected 1.1 to at most n computed QR calls, with early failure and no computed loop in exact QR. The procedure itself and its exact/conditional computed guarantees are unchanged.

Step 1 assigned s_lambda both the vector [r(x);0] and a positive scalar lower bound for the stored augmented matrix. Renamed only the vector to b_lambda, including the solver call and exact identity A_lambda^T b_lambda=J^T r. The scalar certificate remains s_lambda>0 and still certifies the actual stored matrix; exact and computed branches retain their original conditions.

The old Statement allowed n=0 in the library convention, leaving its smallest singular value undefined and calling the positive-dimensional Hessian and QR interfaces outside their scope. Added m,n>=1. On this domain the SVD inverse bound, gradient path integral, 2ML(1-t)||e|| bound, and integrated (kappa+ML||e||)/sigma^2 estimate prove the stated q-contraction and invariant-ball convergence without changing the quantitative claim.

The uniform lower bound alone permits the zero-dimensional case, but the residual remainder and exact QR suppliers explicitly require m,n>=1. Added those dimensions. The existing remainder E, normal orthogonality, Pythagorean bound ||Jh||<=||E||, and ||Jh||>=sigma||h|| establish C=L/(2sigma); the C=0 branch avoids division by C and the stated starting radius closes the invariant-ball induction.

The actual algorithm Definition step 5 does accept a feasible positive-prediction exact trial with rho>=eta1, after determining its next damping. F1 omitted that necessary branch while step 4.1 cited F1 for acceptance. Restored this clause in F1. The step-size, model-error, positive-prediction and geometric rejection-count calculations already prove the large-damping bound and the Nth-trial conclusion under the stated exact-solve/evaluation hypotheses.

F3 overstated the local theorem by listing only curvature control and full rank. Replaced it by the positive-dimensional C2, stationary-point, ball, norm, Lipschitz, curvature and q<1 hypotheses with exact QR inputs. Verification 2.2 now explicitly identifies the polynomial C2 residual and n=1,m=2; 1.1 supplies stationarity and 2.1 supplies QR.
